## Introduction {#sec-apA-intro-en}

This appendix gathers, into complete, self-contained files, the code presented piece by piece in [Chapter 2](cap02.qmd). Each block below is an independent `.html` file, ready to copy into an editor (VSCode or WebStorm) and open directly in the *browser*, with no installation or server configuration required: *Bootstrap* is loaded via *CDN*, and the data shown is fixed directly in the HTML.

This code serves two purposes:

- In class, as an immediate demonstration: copy it, open it in the *browser*, and have a small, working Web site to navigate right away
- In the practical LABs (see [Appendix D](apendiceD1.qmd) onward), as *boilerplate*: the starting point to which the JavaScript needed to consume the REST API is added, without rewriting HTML from scratch

The four files share the same navigation bar and must be saved in the same folder, so that the links between them work: `index.html`, `login.html`, `capital.html` and `paises-editar.html`.

::: {.callout-note}
## A note on the visible text in this appendix's code

The on-screen text inside the four HTML files below (navigation labels, headings, form fields, button captions) is left in Portuguese, exactly as in the Portuguese edition. These are the same literal files, reused verbatim by the practical LABs later in the book ([Appendix D](apendiceD1.qmd) onward), and by the screenshots in [Chapter 2](cap02.qmd) — keeping the text identical keeps code and screenshots consistent across both editions.
:::

## Initial Project Structure {#sec-apA-structure-en}

Before copying the code, the folder structure that will accompany the project throughout the course is created — from the static files in this appendix to the JavaScript *front-office* the practical LABs will add to them:

1. Create a project folder (for example, `world-capitals/`)
2. Inside it, place the four `.html` files from this appendix
3. Create three subfolders, still empty: `css/`, `js/` and `assets/`

```
world-capitals/
├── index.html
├── login.html
├── capital.html
├── paises-editar.html
├── css/
├── js/
└── assets/
```

- `css/`: holds style sheets linked to the `html` pages. It can also hold adjustments to the *Bootstrap* loaded via *CDN*, for instance a `custom.css` with visual tweaks specific to this application. A single style sheet can be used for all the pages, or each page can have its own.
- `js/`: for the *JavaScript* files. It stays empty for now; this is where, in the practical LABs, the `fetch()` code that connects these pages to the REST API will go
- `assets/`: images, icons, or other static files the application may need

This structure is not required by the *browser*: a single, isolated `.html` file, opened directly, already works, as can be confirmed in the following sections. It is, however, the organisation that any real Web project ends up adopting, and it is worth keeping in mind from the start.

## `index.html`: Country Listing {#sec-apA-index-en}

The following page has a navigation bar at the top and a table of countries. Bootstrap is loaded via CDN.

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>World Capitals</title>
  <link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
</head>
<body>
  <nav class="navbar navbar-expand-md bg-light border-bottom">
    <div class="container">
      <a class="navbar-brand" href="index.html">World Capitals</a>
      <button class="navbar-toggler" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#nav1">
        <span class="navbar-toggler-icon"></span>
      </button>
      <div id="nav1" class="collapse navbar-collapse">
        <ul class="navbar-nav ms-auto gap-2">
          <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link active" href="index.html">Países</a></li>
          <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link" href="capital.html">Consultar Capital</a></li>
          <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link" href="paises-editar.html">Gerir Países</a></li>
          <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link" href="login.html">Entrar</a></li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </nav>

  <main class="container my-4">
    <h1 class="display-6">Países</h1>
    <table class="table table-striped">
      <thead>
        <tr><th>Código</th><th>País</th><th>Capital</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td>PT</td><td>Portugal</td><td>Lisboa</td></tr>
        <tr><td>FR</td><td>França</td><td>Paris</td></tr>
        <tr><td>EN</td><td>Reino Unido</td><td>Londres</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </main>

  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
```

## `login.html`: Authentication {#sec-apA-login-en}

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>World Capitals — Entrar</title>
  <link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
</head>
<body>
  <nav class="navbar navbar-expand-md bg-light border-bottom">
    <div class="container">
      <a class="navbar-brand" href="index.html">World Capitals</a>
      <button class="navbar-toggler" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#nav1">
        <span class="navbar-toggler-icon"></span>
      </button>
      <div id="nav1" class="collapse navbar-collapse">
        <ul class="navbar-nav ms-auto gap-2">
          <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link" href="index.html">Países</a></li>
          <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link" href="capital.html">Consultar Capital</a></li>
          <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link" href="paises-editar.html">Gerir Países</a></li>
          <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link active" href="login.html">Entrar</a></li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </nav>

  <main class="container my-4">
    <h1 class="display-6">Entrar</h1>
    <form class="row g-3 col-lg-6" method="POST" action="/login">
      <div class="col-12">
        <label for="user" class="form-label">Utilizador</label>
        <input id="user" name="user" type="text" class="form-control">
      </div>
      <div class="col-12">
        <label for="pass" class="form-label">Palavra-passe</label>
        <input id="pass" name="pass" type="password" class="form-control">
      </div>
      <div class="col-12">
        <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Entrar</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  </main>

  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
```

## `capital.html`: Capital Lookup {#sec-apA-capital-en}

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>World Capitals — Consultar Capital</title>
  <link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
</head>
<body>
  <nav class="navbar navbar-expand-md bg-light border-bottom">
    <div class="container">
      <a class="navbar-brand" href="index.html">World Capitals</a>
      <button class="navbar-toggler" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#nav1">
        <span class="navbar-toggler-icon"></span>
      </button>
      <div id="nav1" class="collapse navbar-collapse">
        <ul class="navbar-nav ms-auto gap-2">
          <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link" href="index.html">Países</a></li>
          <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link active" href="capital.html">Consultar Capital</a></li>
          <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link" href="paises-editar.html">Gerir Países</a></li>
          <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link" href="login.html">Entrar</a></li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </nav>

  <main class="container my-4">
    <h1 class="display-6">Consultar Capital</h1>
    <form class="row g-3 col-lg-6" method="GET" action="/capital">
      <div class="col-12">
        <label for="countrycode" class="form-label">Código do país</label>
        <input id="countrycode" name="countrycode" type="text" maxlength="2" class="form-control">
      </div>
      <div class="col-12">
        <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Consultar</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  </main>

  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
```

## `paises-editar.html`: Country Management {#sec-apA-paises-editar-en}

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>World Capitals — Gerir Países</title>
  <link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
</head>
<body>
  <nav class="navbar navbar-expand-md bg-light border-bottom">
    <div class="container">
      <a class="navbar-brand" href="index.html">World Capitals</a>
      <button class="navbar-toggler" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#nav1">
        <span class="navbar-toggler-icon"></span>
      </button>
      <div id="nav1" class="collapse navbar-collapse">
        <ul class="navbar-nav ms-auto gap-2">
          <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link" href="index.html">Países</a></li>
          <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link" href="capital.html">Consultar Capital</a></li>
          <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link active" href="paises-editar.html">Gerir Países</a></li>
          <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link" href="login.html">Entrar</a></li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </nav>

  <main class="container my-4">
    <h1 class="display-6">Gerir Países</h1>

    <h2 class="h5 mt-4">Inserir país</h2>
    <form class="row g-3 col-lg-6" method="POST" action="/countryEdit">
      <input type="hidden" name="operation" value="insert">
      <div class="col-12">
        <label for="code-i" class="form-label">Código</label>
        <input id="code-i" name="code" type="text" maxlength="2" required class="form-control">
      </div>
      <div class="col-12">
        <label for="name-i" class="form-label">Nome</label>
        <input id="name-i" name="name" type="text" required class="form-control">
      </div>
      <div class="col-12">
        <label for="capital-i" class="form-label">Capital</label>
        <input id="capital-i" name="capital" type="text" required class="form-control">
      </div>
      <div class="col-12">
        <button class="btn btn-success" type="submit">Inserir</button>
      </div>
    </form>

    <h2 class="h5 mt-4">Atualizar país</h2>
    <form class="row g-3 col-lg-6" method="POST" action="/countryEdit">
      <input type="hidden" name="operation" value="update">
      <div class="col-12">
        <label for="code-u" class="form-label">Código</label>
        <input id="code-u" name="code" type="text" maxlength="2" required class="form-control">
      </div>
      <div class="col-12">
        <label for="name-u" class="form-label">Nome</label>
        <input id="name-u" name="name" type="text" required class="form-control">
      </div>
      <div class="col-12">
        <label for="capital-u" class="form-label">Capital</label>
        <input id="capital-u" name="capital" type="text" required class="form-control">
      </div>
      <div class="col-12">
        <button class="btn btn-warning" type="submit">Atualizar</button>
      </div>
    </form>

    <h2 class="h5 mt-4">Remover país</h2>
    <form class="row g-3 col-lg-6" method="POST" action="/countryEdit">
      <input type="hidden" name="operation" value="delete">
      <div class="col-12">
        <label for="code-d" class="form-label">Código</label>
        <input id="code-d" name="code" type="text" maxlength="2" required class="form-control">
      </div>
      <div class="col-12">
        <button class="btn btn-danger" type="submit">Remover</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  </main>

  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
```
